title: Inlet Beach "Tupelo Honey" 17 Pompano Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Beach access is located only 0.1 mile from the home- Community pool *This pool cannot be heated*- Gas grill- Sun deck- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover sweet paradise at Tupelo Honey, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Inlet Beach home with 3,056 square feet of indoor living space that comfortably accommodates 14 guests. Revel in warm-weather fun with the sugar-soft sands of the Emerald Coast—less than a 5-minute walk away—and community pool access across the street. With nearby Rosemary and Alys Beach offering fine dining, shopping, and year-round family fun, this is the perfect setting for a dream coastal getaway!Classic Southern charm welcomes guests to this beautiful 3-level home. Step past the front porch into the first-level great room, adorned with white shiplap walls, pale plank flooring, and elegant beach decor. Enjoy time together in the comfy living area, where 2 slip-covered sofas beckon for comfy nights streaming favorites on the TV! To the side is an extra sitting area with 4 armchairs for intimate conversation. The stunning kitchen offers a picturesque space for crafting culinary delights, with high-end appliances and a vast center island that seats 4. Savor sunlit morning brunches at the wooden table that hosts 6. A back door leads onto the covered back porch, with cushioned seating and stairs to the backyard, where a grill awaits.Venture up the classic staircase to find a second-level living space with a TV, plenty of plush seating, and porch access. The bunk room is perfect for kids and teens with 2 sets of full-over-full beds, while the 2 guest bedrooms each offer a peaceful retreat with a queen bed.Tucked on the third level, the secluded primary bedroom boasts a king bed, a luxurious private bathroom, a sitting area, and a balcony with peek-a-boo views of the Gulf—the ultimate place to welcome the morning with coffee in hand.Experience a laid-back 30A escape at Tupelo Honey in Inlet Beach. Exploring is easy with parking for 3 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes available seasonally. To reach beach access, simply stroll down Pompano Court, turn left at Pompano Place, and turn right onto South Orange Street—the boardwalk is at the end of the road. Book today and start planning an epic Emerald Coast vacation!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:-Kitchen, Living Room, Dining Room and Half Bathroom SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*The garage is not for guest use.

Revel in warm-weather fun with the sugar-soft sands of the Emerald Coast—less than a 5-minute walk away—and community pool access across the street.
